adjudication.rationale: `EmbedController#best` enqueues `:retrieve_topic` whenever `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` returns nil, then renders `embed/loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:11-18). The loading template unconditionally reloads the page every 30 seconds (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:6-11). If retrieval never succeeds (e.g., permanent fetch/parse failure), the page will reload indefinitely and each request will enqueue another `:retrieve_topic` job, since there is no retry cap or backoff in the view/controller logic. Although `TopicRetriever` throttles actual retrieval to once per 60s, the repeated enqueuing/requests still happens.
